## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour change (`npm test`)
- [ ] User docs updated where it matters: `README.md`, `HELP.md` (answers and troubleshooting), `config.example.jsonc` for new settings
- [ ] If features or supported services changed: the summary in `scripts/build-llms.mjs` is still true
- [ ] `npm run build:llms` run, so `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt` match (the pre-commit hook does this for you)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] No keys, emails, personal paths or logs anywhere (`npm run check:secrets`)
- [ ] I agree to the contribution terms in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (I wrote this and license it to the maintainer under MIT)
